# Pro Daily Link

Construction daily reports and production tracking for contractors. Field truth, office clarity.

## What it does

- Field crews submit daily notes by voice or text, in English or Spanish, with photos and crew hours.
- The office reviews once, verifies production against estimate lines, and flags unplanned extra work before it is missed.
- Flat company pricing from $99 per month. No per-seat fees.
